50895619: This line initializes the variable I and X to an empty string, and then uses a series of conditional branches to jump to the label 'A' based on the value of DV and D. 8cd49484: Line S:%]"" X:$D(DIC("S")) DIC("S") I  W:'$D(DB(DQ)) "  "_% G V allows the value of X to be set and written to the screen. It checks if DIC("S") is defined, which is a standard input transform for the field definition. If the transform is successful and DB(DQ) is not defined, it writes the transformed value of X to the screen and goes to label V.

cc920a0e: The loop F %=1:1 S Y=$P(DU,";",%) loops through the individual values in the DU variable, which is a string of values separated by semicolons. For each value, it checks if it contains the current value of X. If so, it runs the input transform DIC("S") if defined and continues to the next value if the transform is successful. Otherwise, it exits the loop.
